meta.indexing: ep_len = len(action)-1; starts idx in [1, ep_len-T+1]; chunk=action[idx:idx+T]
meta.rmse_definition: sqrt(mean over T and D of (recon - a)^2), per chunk (== zoomq.py skeleton_rmse)

round_0.note: no parents; decoded in the full [-1, 1] range

j_star.criterion: smallest j in [2, 3, 5, 9, 16] with mean per-chunk RMSE <= 0.05

w_table_per_dim.description: w[r][d] = window_scale * p99(|a[t] - p_t|) over round r's knots and action dim d only, clamped into [w_min, w_max]; round 0 is the full range (1.0). Rows are rounds 0..R-1, columns are dims 0..D-1.
w_table_per_dim.exec_match_fraction_note: exec_n_r depends only on the dyadic reconstruction RMSE, which never reads the windows, so the per-dim table leaves it identical to exec_match_fraction.
